request.text: On September 1, 2026, at 9:15 p.m. Shanghai time, remind me once: ‘Take the prescribed 5-milligram tablet with a full glass of water.’ Keep the dose in the reminder, and don't make it recurring.

responsibilities.outcome: Create one nonrecurring reminder for the specified Shanghai date and time to take the prescribed 5-milligram tablet with a full glass of water.

bindings.reminder_content: Take the prescribed 5-milligram tablet with a full glass of water.

semantic_facts: The reminder must be grounded to September 1, 2026 at 9:15 p.m. in Shanghai time and must be created only once.
The reminder text must retain the user-supplied 5-milligram dose and full-glass-of-water instruction without treating either value as scheduling data.
The reversible state change must respect the catalog's confirmation boundary before being represented as created.
forbidden_claims: The planner changes the date, time zone, dose, water instruction, or recurrence pattern.
The planner endorses the medication regimen or claims that the reminder has already been created before required confirmation and execution evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A dose or hydration quantity is confused with the reminder's due time or omitted from its content.
An exact one-time reminder is shifted across time zones, made recurring, or represented as completed before confirmation and evidence.
